item.title: About
item.description:
I’m an embedded software developer based in Querétaro, Mexico.

My professional experience includes C and C++ development for embedded applications, debugging, software testing, technical documentation, and development tooling.

I’ve worked with microcontrollers, RTOS-based systems, and Linux applications.

I’m currently developing my skills further in C++, Linux, systems programming, build systems, testing, and software architecture.
